title: Posting Deposits to Resident Trust Fund Accounts
content:
**Rule.** Deposits to the Resident Trust Fund Accounts are accepted from the listed sources. A deposited personal check becomes available for withdrawal after the check deposit hold business days, counting Monday through Friday and excluding bank holidays; cash, direct deposits and benefits are available on the day posted. Benefits the center receives as representative payee are posted within the benefit posting business days and are applied first to the resident's current maintenance and then saved in the account. A deposit is posted only while the account is active.

## Condition checked before posting

The account named on the deposit must show as active on the center's own account record at the time of posting. An account awaiting authorization, in conveyance, closed or declined takes no deposit.

## Availability by kind of deposit

| Deposit | Day it can be withdrawn |
|---|---|
| resident's cash | the day posted |
| pension paid by direct deposit | the day posted |
| Social Security benefit received as representative payee | the day posted |
| refund from the center | the day posted |
| family member's personal check | after the check deposit hold business days |

Each deposit carries the date it was received and the date it becomes available for withdrawal.

## Benefits received as payee

Where the center is the resident's SSA representative payee, a benefit is posted within the benefit posting business days after it is received, and is applied first to the resident's current maintenance, with what remains saved in the account. Where the center is not payee, this ordering does not arise.
